findings.text: normalizeFileUrl does not validate URL scheme before calling fileURLToPath; passing new URL('https://example.com') throws an unhandled ERR_INVALID_URL_SCHEME error instead of a clear validation error.

0.reason: The finding describes behavior of normalizeFileUrl with an https URL, but the code intentionally delegates to fileURLToPath which throws the standard error, and this is not the reference bug about process.execPath being a String object under Deno.
